documentedExceptions: Source wording and contact details have been replaced with the approved FIT HOME content.
The Hebrew copy uses localized line wrapping and headline fitting while retaining the outlined-primary and solid-yellow-secondary hierarchy.
The CTA capsule is widened locally to fit the approved Hebrew label without reducing readability.
The replacement photograph preserves the reference image region's placement and visual role; matching the reference's particular subject, pose or equipment is not required.

issues.impact: Natural skin and background colors introduce additional color emphasis into the reference's black, white and yellow styling. The image still balances the text and does not compromise readability or headline prominence.

The business identity appears below the body rather than at the planned upper-left position, so readers encounter the brand later. The small yellow rule above it adds a minor separator, but neither addition materially disrupts the preserved headline-to-CTA flow.
